services.name: first-time kayaker
services.desc: Had another wonderful marine Life Kayak Tour. We started the morning out watching some dolphins that were fishing in the pass. They swam up very close to us for quick inspection and then went back to their feeding. We sat to watch them for a short while then on to the netting part of the tour. We caught small pufferfish, a few pygmy seahorses, live lightning whelks, and various crustaceans. We also caught site of a pair of bald eagle, and several other bird species. It was yet another spectacular Marine Life Kayak Adventure. Explore the waters of Fort Myers Beach with Good Time Charters!
